Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
Depthmode: Depth encoding on in2. linear: eye-space distance in R, in world units. nonlinear: raw Render TOP depth buffer, linearised with Near and Far.
Near: Camera near clip distance. Must match the Camera COMP (nonlinear depth only).
Far: Camera far clip distance. Must match the Camera COMP. Depths at or beyond it count as sky.
Depthscale: Multiplier applied to the depth values to convert them to the same units as Radius.
Normalenc: Normal encoding on in3. signed: view-space XYZ in -1..1. packed: encoded 0..1.
Fov: Camera vertical field of view in degrees, used to rebuild view-space positions. Match your camera.
Radius: Sampling radius of the occlusion in world units. Larger = broader, softer shadowing.
Samples: Hemisphere samples per pixel (4-64). More = smoother but slower.
Bias: Offset that prevents surfaces from shadowing themselves. Raise if flat surfaces look dirty.
Power: Contrast curve of the AO. Higher = darker, more contrasty occlusion.
Blur: Blur radius in pixels applied to the AO mask before it is multiplied into the colour. 0 = raw, noisy AO.
